purpose: Plan a read-only adapter that lets UI inspect Data Model records without replacing current Control Center runtime logic.

adapterLayers.name: Data Loader
adapterLayers.rule: Load JSON files as read-only references only.

adapterLayers.name: Record Normalizer
adapterLayers.rule: Generate preview records in memory only; do not write files.

adapterLayers.name: UI Preview Renderer
adapterLayers.rule: Render data model preview without replacing existing UI controls.

adapterLayers.name: Safety Guard
adapterLayers.rule: Block activation, migration, write, delete and git actions.

allowedActions: load data model JSON as text/reference
compare data model shape against current UI concepts
blockedActions: activate data model as source of truth
activationRequirements: Adapter Plan QA Gate must pass.
Read-only Adapter Preview must be built.
Read-only Adapter Preview QA must pass.
Manual approval required before any source-of-truth activation.
